projects.title: Bluekites LMS Platform
projects.description: Rescued and optimized a failing Learning Management System (LMS) that was left broken by a previous developer, fixing over 1000+ errors, improving performance, and ensuring security, scalability, and client satisfaction.
projects.longDescription: This project started as a rescue mission. The client was left with a completely broken Learning Management System (LMS) by their previous developer—over 1000+ errors across frontend and backend, sluggish performance, poor security, and no proper architecture.
solutions: Restructured the entire codebase, implemented reusable components, and optimized performance
Systematic debugging and refactoring eliminated the major issues
Implemented JWT-based authentication, integrated an optimized verification system
Introduced Redux, optimized rendering, and restructured components
Optimized database indexing, refactored API logic, and integrated Redis caching
Regular communication, progress reports, and transparent problem-solving
features: Fully Optimized LMS with clean architecture

projects.title: TechTornadoV2
projects.description: A real-time game platform with a WebSocket backend, Next.js admin panel, and VPS-hosted deployment. Built under extreme time constraints.
projects.longDescription: TechTornadoV2 was not just another project—it was a high-pressure challenge that pushed both technical and leadership boundaries. What started as a simple database request from a faculty member and a group of juniors quickly evolved into a full-fledged real-time game platform.
solutions: Implemented a WebSocket-based backend using Node.js to handle live game state updates
Rebuilt the frontend from scratch with modern UI and efficient API consumption
Secured custom domain and set up VPS hosting with reverse proxy configuration
Worked nights and coordinated efficiently with the team to meet deadlines

projects.title: CodeLoom
projects.description: A GitHub repository structure extraction tool that allows users to fetch complete folder and file structures from public and private GitHub repositories as well as ZIP Folder.
projects.longDescription: CodeLoom is a GitHub repository structure extraction tool that simplifies the process of understanding and sharing repository structures. It's designed to help developers, especially those working with AI tools, to better understand and communicate their codebase structure.
solutions: Implemented robust GitHub API integration with proper error handling
Developed secure authentication flow for private repositories
Created efficient ZIP file processing system
Designed intuitive UI with clear feedback and progress indicators
